usedFor: Razorpay processes payments, and Sukam Apps CRM records the customer through “Create Contact” after “A New Refund Is Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “A New Refund Is Created” in Razorpay, then “Create Contact” in Sukam Apps CRM
bestTemplate.why: A refund is a signal worth following up, so the customer lands in the CRM with the fields you set.

watchOut: “Create a Lead” and “Create Contact” both fit this trigger, so choose one or the same refund adds two records.
